constraints.name: Employee data protection
constraints.rationale_summary: Processing employee names and financial claim data is a standard obligation for any UK internal system — not a feasibility blocker.
constraints.reasoning: Identified via the cross-domain regulator index as the applicable body/framework for any system processing employee personal data; classified Green since this is a routine, not novel, obligation.

constraints.name: Financial record retention
constraints.rationale_summary: Approval/claim records are accounting records requiring statutory minimum retention; allowing early deletion would create a compliance gap.
constraints.mitigation_summary: Design the tool so claim/approval records cannot be deleted before the statutory retention period elapses, and are exportable for audit.
constraints.reasoning: Not covered by either attached KB (this example falls outside the food domain); resolved via tool-L1-regulatory-db-lookup instead.

overall_status.rationale_summary: CON-02 (financial record retention) is the worst constraint at Amber, with a concrete, precedented mitigation. No Red item exists.
